displayName: MDO - BEC Display-Name Impersonation of Executive

queryCondition.queryText:
let Execs = dynamic(["CEO Name","CFO Name","Managing Director"]);
let CorpDomains = dynamic(["contoso.com","contoso.es"]);
EmailEvents
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| where SenderDisplayName has_any (Execs)
| where not(SenderFromDomain in~ (CorpDomains))
| project Timestamp, ReportId, SenderDisplayName, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, DeliveryAction, NetworkMessageId

alertTemplate.title: BEC display-name impersonation of executive
alertTemplate.description: Inbound email uses an executive's display name but originates from a non-corporate sender domain - the classic CEO-fraud / BEC pattern. Customise the Execs and CorpDomains lists in the query.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Verify any requested action out-of-band with the impersonated executive. Warn the recipient, block the sender/domain, and search for other recipients of the same lure.
